items.exampleEn: We waited an eternity for our food at that restaurant.
items.exampleZh: 我們在那家餐廳等上菜等了好久好久。

items.exampleEn: I'm tired of the continual noise from the street.
items.exampleZh: 我受夠了街上不斷的噪音。

items.exampleEn: Please list your jobs in chronological order.
items.exampleZh: 請依時間先後列出你做過的工作。

items.exampleEn: We are going on holiday for a fortnight.
People used a sundial to tell the time long ago.
items.exampleZh: 很久以前，人們用日晷來看時間。

items.exampleEn: My father still uses an old-fashioned phone.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸還在用一支老式的電話。

items.exampleEn: This is an out-of-date map; many roads have changed.
items.exampleZh: 這是一張過時的地圖，很多路都變了。

items.exampleEn: The website gives up-to-date news about the weather.
items.exampleZh: 這個網站提供最新的天氣消息。

items.sentenceEn: I will visit my parents again in a fortnight.
items.sentenceZh: 我兩星期後會再去看我爸媽。

items.audioEn: The office had continual problems with the printer, so we bought a new one last week.
items.audioZh: 辦公室的印表機一直出問題，所以我們上星期買了一台新的。
items.questionZh: 辦公室上星期為什麼買新的印表機？
options: The old one was too slow
The office moved to a bigger new place

items.sentenceEn: The story is told in chronological order, from childhood to old age.
items.sentenceZh: 這個故事是按時間順序講的，從童年到老年。

items.sentenceEn: Some people think writing letters is old-fashioned.
items.sentenceZh: 有些人覺得寫信很過時。

items.stemEn: We can't use this ____ phone list; half of the numbers have changed.
items.stemZh: 我們不能用這份過時的電話名單，有一半的號碼都換了。

items.stemEn: My boss will be away for a ____, so he will be back in two weeks.
items.stemZh: 我老闆要離開兩星期，所以他兩週後會回來。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, Leo visited a small museum about time. In the first room, the objects are shown in chronological order, starting with an old sundial from a garden. Next to it, there is an old-fashioned clock that needs continual care. In the last room, a big screen gives up-to-date information about the time in different cities. Leo stayed for three hours, but it did not feel like an eternity at all. He plans to come back in a fortnight with his son.
items.passageZh: 上週末，Leo 參觀了一間關於時間的小博物館。第一個展間的展品按時間先後排列，從一個來自花園的古老日晷開始。旁邊有一座老式時鐘，需要不斷照顧。最後一個展間有一個大螢幕，顯示各個城市的最新時間資訊。Leo 待了三個小時，但一點也不覺得漫長。他打算兩星期後帶兒子再來。

questions.questionZh: 第一個展間的展品是怎麼排列的？
Leo 打算什麼時候再來？

items.promptZh: 我們開會需要最新的資料。
referenceEn: We need up-to-date information for the meeting.
For the meeting, we need the most up-to-date information.
rubricZh: up-to-date 放在名詞前表示「最新的」（例如 up-to-date information）
寫成 the latest information 等也正確
information 是不可數名詞，不加 s

items.promptZh: 這間博物館的照片是按照時間順序排列的。
referenceEn: The photos in this museum are arranged in chronological order.
This museum shows its photos in chronological order.
rubricZh: 用 chronological 表示「按時間順序的」（例如 in chronological order）
「排列」可寫，例如 are arranged、are shown、are put 等
